description: Connection status and manual network lifecycle.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: The latest `connection://status` value; `idle` without a session. Hosts subscribe to the status event for changes and read this once at startup.

methods.name: reconnectNow
methods.description: The banner's retry action: resets the backoff and starts the next round at once. No effect while online, connecting or stopped for a user action; fails with notConnected without a session.

methods.name: getServerClock
methods.description: The core's estimate of the server clock, from the server timestamps on the connection's frames. Hosts judge server-issued instants (plugin card deadlines and countdowns, cooldown ends) against device time + offsetMs. Until estimated (no session, or no server frame yet this session) offsetMs is 0; keep the last estimate, or the device clock without one.

methods.name: notifyNetworkChange
methods.description: Tells the link supervisor the platform network changed. The platform lifecycle installed at init calls it; the supervisor alone decides whether and how to reconnect.
